tx:
Players can use a bucket on a dairy cow to gain a bucket of milk, or simply click on the dairy cow when they have at least one empty bucket in their inventory.
Buckets of milk can also be bought in bulk from The Milk Shop for 12 coins; doing so with War's Retreat Teleport and an explorer's ring 3/4 is potentially one of the fastest ways to make money in free-to-play.
Two dairy cows can also be found next to Gillie Groats in east Lumbridge a fairly short distance away from the bank chest in Lumbridge Market, but this location has no milk seller.
Members can obtain unlimited buckets of milk from any type of larder in their player-owned houses. Buckets of milk spawn in a hut in the eastern part of Rellekka and in the north central building of Marigold Farm in Havenhythe.
